title: Protected console handlers
responsibility: Creates console handlers that check host policy before releasing stored JSON, media, build identity or downloadable reports.

inputs.name: consoleAccess.options
inputs.type: { policy: ConsolePolicy; data: ConsoleSource; host?: ConsoleHost; }
inputs.description: Creates request handlers from a policy and a console data source, with optional host build metadata used by `build.json`. The policy may be synchronous or asynchronous but admits a request only when it resolves to exactly `true`; request-scoped data is opened only after admission.

outputs.name: consoleAccess
outputs.description: Returns `guard`, `entry`, `json` and `media` handlers; each applies the policy and returns a 403 response unless it resolves exactly to `true`, and the data source is opened only for admitted requests. `entry` can return a 308 redirect or `undefined`, while JSON and media handlers return responses, including 404 for missing or disallowed resources and 206/416 for media range responses.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: A malformed `index.json` string returned for a root or query entry request makes `JSON.parse` throw. The `entry` handler does not catch this syntax error.

errors.name: Source error
errors.description: A synchronous error from the request-scoped `ConsoleSource`, or a rejection from `ConsoleData.json` or `ConsoleData.media`, propagates from its handler unchanged. The injected source determines the actual error name and value; the handler does not normalize it.
